about: 관리 > 공제항목등록 [계산식](E090114) — 원본 2026-10-13 실측: 공제리스트 계산식 칸 → 계산식리스트(사우회비 2010/01 ~ R( 사우회비(급여지급사항) , 0 )) → 신규(F2) 계산식등록(공제항목코드 · 공제항목명 · 적용시점 · 계산식예시 · 불러오기 · 계산식등록|조건 · 계산도구 · 찾기 목록(급여지급사항에 공제항목까지 · 공제 · 기타 · 계산항목 산출금액)). 줄 끝 [조건] 을 켜면 조건1 · [참1] · [거짓1] 과 계산도구 (조건) AND · OR · = · > · < · >= · <= · <>. 원본 건강보험 식 '[조건1] 장기요양보험(공제구분) > 0, [참1] 건강보험산출금액(계산항목), [거짓1] …', 주민세 'F( ( 소득세(공제구분) * 0.1 ) * 0.1 ) * 10'. 원본에는 저장하지 않았다. 우리: 조건 식을 화면에서 쌓아 저장 → 급여명세 공제 줄이 그 값, 공제구분 식은 소득세 줄로 셈. 시험 항목 · 사원은 지운다.

shots.name: 공제 계산식 — 설정 → 신규 → [조건] 켜기 → 조건1 · 참1 · 거짓1 → 저장 → 급여명세 38,000 / 10,000 · 주민세 식 → 정리
steps: js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};for(const x of (await (await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items',{headers:h})).json()).filter(x=>x.name==='QA관리-조건공제'||x.name==='QA관리-주민세식'))await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items/'+x.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});const mk=async(n,o)=>(await (await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({code:'QAD'+o+(Date.now()%10000),name:n,kind:'DEDUCTION',taxable:false,defaultAmount:0,active:true,sortOrder:90+o,taxFreeType:null,payMethod:'FIXED'})})).json()).id;const a=await mk('QA관리-조건공제',1);const b=await mk('QA관리-주민세식',2);await fetch('/api/pay-settings/items/'+b+'/formulas',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({effectiveFrom:'2091-01',formula:'F( ( 소득세(공제구분) * 0.1 ) * 0.1 ) * 10'})});sessionStorage.setItem('qaDfItems',a+','+b);const e=await (await fetch('/api/employees',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'QA관리-공제식',hireDate:'2091-01-01',baseSalary:3800000,payType:'FIXED'})})).json();sessionStorage.setItem('qaDfEmp',String(e.id));return !!a&&!!b&&!!e.id})()

js:(async()=>{for(let k=0;k<20;k++){const tr=[...document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr')].find(tr=>[...tr.querySelectorAll('input')].some(i=>i.value==='QA관리-조건공제'));const b=tr&&(tr.querySelector('button.ec-link')||[...tr.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='설정'));if(b){b.click();return true}await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,500))}return false})()

js:(()=>{const set=(lbl,v)=>{const s=document.querySelector('[role=dialog] select[aria-label="'+lbl+'"]');if(![...s.options].some(o=>o.value===v)){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v;o.text=v;s.add(o)}Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set.call(s,v);s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}))};set('적용시점 연도','2091');set('적용시점 월','01');return true})()

js:(()=>{const put=(l,v)=>{const ta=document.querySelector('[role=dialog] textarea[aria-label="계산식 '+l+'"]');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype,'value').set.call(ta,v);ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};const c=document.querySelector('[role=dialog] textarea[aria-label="계산식 조건1"]').value;put('조건1',c+'3000000');put('[참1]','R( 지급총액(기타) * 0.01 , 0 )');put('[거짓1]','10000');return true})()

js:(async()=>{const h={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};const e=Number(sessionStorage.getItem('qaDfEmp'));const pay=async()=>{const p=await (await fetch('/api/payslips',{method:'POST',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({employeeId:e,payMonth:'2091-07'})})).json();const g=n=>Number(((p.lines||[]).find(l=>l.name===n)||{}).amount||0);const r=[g('QA관리-조건공제'),g('QA관리-주민세식')===Math.floor(g('소득세')*0.01)*10&&g('소득세')>0];if(p.id)await fetch('/api/payslips/'+p.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:h});return r};const a=await pay();await fetch('/api/employees/'+e,{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({name:'QA관리-공제식',hireDate:'2091-01-01',baseSalary:2500000,payType:'FIXED'})});const b=await pay();sessionStorage.setItem('qaDfCalc',a.join('/')+'|'+b.join('/'));return true})()
